decisive_items: directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light (30 chip-on-board LEDs emitting 5 W, 100 lm/W at 500 mA) at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
response.rationale: C1 is more complete because it adds the strongly raw-supported LED-light etiology to the same phototoxic maculopathy diagnosis, while R3 supplies excellent outer retinal OCT evidence but its own raw support spans omit the causative exposure. The OCT findings are decisive shared raw context confirming retinal phototoxicity, but only C1 integrates this with the specific LED exposure that is central to the diagnosis.
